groups.topic: Ascendant to Jupiter body: alleged life benefit, status-dependent favors, radix-dependent disease exceptions
r: CHAP CLIX The Ascendant directed to Body of Jupiter
Printed CLIX starts lower PDF691 after separate divider following Saturn CLVIII; first astrological case is Jupiter body.
Ascendant directed to Body of Jupiter
The direction of natal Ascendant to Jupiter's BODY is the initial source condition.
The author alleges general physical health under Jupiter body, not measured health.
Cheerfulness and agreeableness are claimed as separate psychological outcomes.
religious delighting converse with good men
Source associates religiosity and social company with Jupiter; no factual inference about faith.
An alleged increase in resources comes through outside patronage, not necessarily earnings.
Social credit is an alleged independent outcome from fortune.
successful year good end of actions
A broadly favorable year is claimed, without an objective success threshold.
Self-reported contentment is a different possible endpoint from wealth.
if years and conveniences concur marry
Marriage is only alleged if suitable age and other circumstances concur.
Church man University degree or Benefice
For clergy the alleged alternative is academic rank or benefice rather than marriage.
Have regard what Jupiter signifies in Radix
The author explicitly directs the astrologer to natal Jupiter's condition before predicting.
A watery and peregrine Jupiter forms a negative medical modifier even for body case.
An old illness category is asserted for weak Jupiter, not a reliable diagnosis.
Air-sign Jupiter is alleged to yield the same old pox/measles association.
Fire-sign Jupiter creates a different source fever alternative.
Earth-sign Jupiter is associated with scurvy, no verified physiology.
The source says Jupiter body confers some good even when illness appears, an unfalsifiability risk.
The supposed favorable outcome further depends on the natal house Jupiter rules.
Natal Jupiter strength further modifies favor despite same direction.
Unexpected land or inheritance is alleged as a specific alternate outcome.
Childbirth is another alternative outcome rather than financial prosperity.
Fortune by means Stranger no consanguinity
A stranger or unrelated helper is another proposed cause.
The author suggests association with Jupiter-type people; not a verified causal recommendation.
